pipelines.overview: Greenfield pipeline definitions for building a new product from scratch. Use when the user wants to create something new (e.g. /greenfield command). When user provides JIRA ID or SOW (instead of PRD): entry is brainstorm first — orchestrator delegates to brainstorm to deeply understand requirements with user (Q&A/brainstorm), then brainstorm hands off to prd. When idea is already structured and no JIRA/SOW: entry can be prd. Orchestrator selects entry mode based on idea maturity and input type (JIRA/SOW vs PRD vs raw idea). Brainstorm-idea lets users deep dive into the situation and explore better solution ideas before committing to a path. Explicit UI change: When the user explicitly requests a change in UI, use prototype (create/update) → plan (create/update) first before code; use architect (create/update) only when there is API or architecture impact. See .nayan/guidance/pipeline-entry-points.md.

pipeline.description: New product from scratch. Full SDLC from idea to deployment.
pipeline.when_to_use: User has an app idea or wants to build a new product. No existing codebase.

entry.description: When user provides JIRA ID or SOW (instead of PRD): always use first to deeply understand requirements with user (Q&A/brainstorm)
When idea is raw or unstructured; helps clarify scope and requirements
